title: Tag domain objects as auditable
description: Auditable is an empty marker interface. AuditLogger.log() records an entry only for objects that implement Auditable — all others are silently ignored. Mark Order and Payment as auditable, leave Product unmarked, then complete AuditLogger.log() to check the marker at runtime.
hints: Auditable has no methods — implementing it is purely a tag
Use 'instanceof Auditable' inside log() to decide whether to record the entry
Order and Payment should implement Auditable; Product should not
issues: Without a marker, AuditLogger must maintain a hard-coded list of which classes to log
Adding a new auditable type requires changing AuditLogger instead of just the new class
overallGoal: Use the Marker Interface pattern so any class can opt in to audit logging simply by implementing Auditable, with no changes to AuditLogger.
goals: Define an Auditable marker interface with no methods
Implement Auditable on Order and Payment but not on Product
In AuditLogger.log(), use instanceof Auditable to decide whether to record the object
